content.text:
The suite is green. The test wasn't flaky, and it was right. The code had a bug, so I fixed the code and left the test alone.

`invoiceDate` in `invoice.js` used the local-time getters (`getFullYear`, `getMonth`, `getDate`). Its own comment says invoices are dated in UTC, and the test sets `TZ=Asia/Tokyo`. At 23:30 UTC on March 5 it's already March 6 in Tokyo, so the function returned the wrong day. I switched it to `getUTCFullYear`, `getUTCMonth` and `getUTCDate`.

This also fixes a real production bug. Any server not running in UTC would have been misdating late-evening invoices, not just CI.
